messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the stair enclosure are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? This is becoming a priority as fabrication approaches. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected. Please respond within five days so we can proceed with fabrication.
